audit: Labels were 'XS (34)' etc. with chest/waist only. Official men's chart: XS–XXXL = UK/US 34–46; chest and waist were 0.5–1 cm off (XS chest 87 → 86.5, waist 71 → 72; XL waist 92 → 92.5; XXL waist 97 → 97.5; XXXL chest 117 → 116.5, waist 102 → 102.5). Added seat/full hip (90–120) and EU from the men's conversion chart (44–54; XXXL has no EU there, so none stored). Old /pages/size-guide URL is gone.

Was 6 rows XS–XXL with one UK/EU size per letter (XS = UK 34 / EU 44), single values and US sizes. Official ARKET men's Tops chart: XS = EU 42 / UK 32R, then each letter spans two sizes (S = EU 44–46 / UK 34R–36R … XXL = EU 60–62 / UK 50R–52R), with cm ranges. M chest 98 → 96–100, waist 83 → 84–88; XS chest 88 → 84, waist 73 → 72. No US sizes on the official chart. ARKET's separate Shirts chart (collar sizes) is not used. Duplicate of arket-m2 (same brand and chart).

Official ARKET men's Tops chart: XS = EU 42 / UK 32R, then each letter spans two sizes (S = EU 44–46 / UK 34R–36R … XXL = EU 60–62 / UK 50R–52R), with cm ranges. Old chest figures were 4–5 cm low: XS 82 → 86.5, M 92 → 96.5, L 98 → 102.5, XL 104 → 108.5. Official Main Range tops chart is chest only (waist removed; bottoms are sized by waist number) and stops at XL; XXL removed. 2XL–5XL are a separate Plus range (UK 44–50), not stored. UK, US & AUS share one row (34–42). Old /size-guide URL moved to /pages/informational/size-guide.

Was XS–XXL with single chest/waist values and UK 34–44 / US / EU conversions that Fred Perry doesn't publish for menswear. Official letter chart gives chest only, as cm ranges, XS–XXXL: XS 85 → 81–86, M 94 → 97–102, L 100 → 104–109, XXL 112 → 119–124; XXXL added. Waist and UK/US/EU removed (waist is only given for numeric trouser sizes). Fred Perry also publishes a numeric chest-size chart (36–46 = 92–117 cm) for items sized that way; not stored here. Old /size-guide URL is a 404.
